titolo: Mistral releases open weights for 1‑trillion‑parameter Large 4 model “Le Chonk”
descr: Mistral makes its trillion‑parameter, multimodal Large 4 model available with open weights, targeting coding agents and cybersecurity.
paragrafi: Mistral AI announced that the weights for its flagship model Mistral Large 4, nicknamed “Le Chonk,” are now publicly downloadable. The model has 1 trillion parameters overall and 52 billion active parameters, and it is natively multimodal with support for more than 160 languages.

The release follows three weeks of additional reinforcement learning that boosted performance on several benchmarks. The model scored 19.7% on Cognition’s FrontierCode 2.0, 48% on Artificial Analysis’s Coding Agent Index (matching GLM‑5.3 while using 47% fewer tokens), and 41% on Terminal‑Bench 4.0, a 13‑point rise from the preview.
In cybersecurity tests, Large 4 achieved 51% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index and refused 96.6% of malicious requests, the highest rate among open models.
Mistral positions Large 4 as a sovereign alternative to closed‑source models from OpenAI and Anthropic, especially for enterprises that need on‑prem AI for coding and security workloads.
perche: Open weights let organizations run a trillion‑parameter model inside their own firewalls, giving full control over data and inference costs. For users seeking free or locally hosted AI, Large 4 offers state‑of‑the‑art coding and cyber‑defense capabilities without relying on external providers, while still allowing commercial fine‑tuning under a permissive MIT‑style license.
